newPageObjects: No new Playwright page object is required — PerkDetailsPage.js (header + edit-mode) and PerksPage.js field-state/delete-modal extensions already cover the story. One reusable HELPER extension is needed (not a POM): extend automation/helpers/ApiHelper.js with a status/type-aware fixture factory createPerk({type,status,...}) so specs create their own fixtures rather than test.skip when a status/type is absent (addresses tester feedback). It must (a) support all four types — discount-coupon, merchant-cashback, category-cashback, general-cashback (generalizing the current general-cashback-only builder) — and (b) drive lifecycle status by date: Planned = start_date in the future, Active = start_date past + end_date future, Expired = end_date past; return the created perk id/title for table lookup. If getEditableFieldMatrix's control list does not yet cover coupon code/type, cashback limit, exclusions, and category name&MCC controls, add those controlname mappings on PerksPage (extension of the existing selector map, not a new POM).

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/perk_details_header_buttons.spec.js
specs.description: AC-01/02/03/04 · HLS 1,2,4,5. Across Planned, Active, Expired perks (create each fixture via ApiHelper.createPerk if absent — never skip): assert header shows BOTH Delete and Edit (expectBothHeaderButtons). Planned → Delete active + magenta (isDeleteButtonEnabled + getDeleteButtonStyle.isMagenta) and clicking opens the confirmation prompt. Active & Expired → Delete dimmed/non-interactive (attemptDeleteExpectNoPrompt.promptShown===false). Expired → Edit also dimmed/non-interactive (attemptEditExpectNoEditMode.enteredEditMode===false).

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/delete_planned_perk_confirmation.spec.js
specs.description: AC-02 · HLS 3. Create a Planned perk fixture via ApiHelper. Confirm path: clickDelete → confirmDeleteAndCapture → perk removed from list/details. Cancel path: clickDelete → cancelDeleteDialog → perk unchanged and still listed. Assert confirmation copy via getDeleteDialogText.

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/edit_planned_full_edit_mode.spec.js
specs.description: AC-05/17 · HLS 6,17. Planned perk fixture → clickEdit → isInEditMode; assert full edit (all fields editable) EXCEPT perk type (isPerkTypeLocked). Verify creation-parity validations (mandatory fields, char limits, image specs, EN/AR) reusing B10-56729 create_perk generators/expectations.

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/edit_active_common_fields.spec.js
specs.description: AC-06/07/13 · HLS 7,8,14. Active perk fixture → clickEdit → getEditableFieldMatrix asserts the common editable set is editable (title EN/AR, short description EN/AR, subheader EN/AR where applicable, cover photo EN/AR, logo EN/AR, Section, short usage description EN/AR, valid branches EN/AR, short cashback processing description EN/AR, end date & time, short duration description EN/AR) and that all other fields are locked/read-only and visually greyed (isFieldLocked + computed-style check).

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/edit_active_type_specific_fields.spec.js
specs.description: AC-08/09/10/11/12 · HLS 10,11,12,13. Data-driven over the four Active types (fixtures via ApiHelper.createPerk per type). Discount/Coupon → Coupon code + Coupon type (Online/Physical) additionally editable. Merchant Cashback & Category Cashback → Cashback limit editable. General Cashback → Cashback limit + Exclusions (Excluded Categories/Merchants) editable. Category Cashback → Category name & MCC LOCKED while Section remains editable (comment-clarified AC-12).

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/edit_active_save_integrity_and_regression.spec.js
specs.description: AC-14 · HLS 15,16,20. Active perk fixture: capture getDisplayedStatus + getStartDateValue, edit a permitted field, save, re-open → status unchanged and start date not reset. Negative no-op: interacting with a locked field / dimmed button triggers no change. Regression: opening details from the list renders correct per-status buttons; leaving/cancelling edit mode persists nothing; existing listing unaffected.

specs.name: B10-56759/automation/tests/perk_details_localization_and_figma_visual.spec.js
specs.description: AC-13 · HLS 9,18,19. Bilingual edit of an Active perk: edit and verify EN (en-US) and AR (ar-EG) variants of all bilingual fields; verify RTL layout + Arabic button labels. Visual comparison via VisualComparisonHelper against the SCOPE-ONLY exported Perk Details Figma frames (active-magenta Delete, dimmed Delete/Edit, greyed locked fields) — only scope frames exported through FigmaExporter, not the whole dashboard.

notes: Reuse-before-build confirmed against docs/ai/automation (coding-standards + reusable-components): the story POM PerkDetailsPage.js and PerksPage.js field-state/delete-modal extensions already exist and cover AC-01–14; no new page object is introduced.
